content.short: AllDomains is the Web3 identity layer for creating, customizing, and trading blockchain-based domains.
content.description: AllDomains offers a premium Web3 domain on Solana, designed to help you take control of your blockchain identity. As a decentralized name service, it provides an affordable method to host personal data on-chain while keeping you in control of your own information. The service maps a human-readable name to a Solana wallet address, simplifying interactions with wallets, exchanges, and dApps and making identity verification more intuitive across the Solana ecosystem. This makes your identity easier to share and use with participating apps.
